name_zh: 比苏德斯基/波兰/军团/联邦：联邦主义与军团边疆建国
description_zh: 约泽夫·比苏德斯基 (1867-1935) 波兰元帅/国家首脑 (1918-1922, 1926-1935)/社会党/军团/一战/奥匈/德国/苏联/战争/1920 华沙/奇迹/联邦/构想/立陶宛/白俄罗斯/乌克兰/米热/边疆/政变/1926/威权/治理/遗产/比苏德斯基/波兰。核心模式：联邦主义军团边疆 — 军团/联邦/华沙/奇迹/边疆/立陶宛/白俄罗斯/乌克兰/威权/遗产/比苏德斯基/波兰。体现 M261 联邦主义/军团/边疆 — 以"军团+联邦+奇迹+边疆"四位一体，在德/俄/奥/三大帝国夹击中构建波兰联邦主义军团边疆建国范式。
description_en: Jozef Pilsudski (1867-1935) Polish Marshal/Head of State (1918-1922, 1926-1935)/Socialist Party/Legions/WWI/Austria-Hungary/Germany/USSR/war/1920 Warsaw/Miracle/Federation/concept/Lithuania/Belarus/Ukraine/Miedzymorze/borderlands/coup/1926/authoritarian/governance/legacy/Pilsudski/Poland. Core model: Federalism Legionary Frontier — legions/federation/miracle/borderlands/Lithuania/Belarus/Ukraine/authoritarian/legacy/Pilsudski/Poland. Exemplifies M261 Federalism/Legions/Frontier — quaternity of 'legions + federation + miracle + frontier' building Polish federalism legionary frontier nation-building paradigm amid triple imperial squeeze of Germany/Russia/Austria-Hungary.
reason_zh: 比苏德斯基非单纯独裁者，而是"军团+联邦+奇迹+边疆"四位一体联邦建国者。以军团夺回独立，以华沙奇迹阻止红军西进，以联邦构想整合边疆民族。M261 区隔于 M259 乌尔马尼斯威权(乌尔马尼斯)、M260 斯梅特纳语言(斯梅特纳)、M257 曼纳海姆战争(曼纳海姆)，核心在于"军团即独立武力+联邦即地缘想象+奇迹即生存胜利+边疆即战略纵深"的波兰联邦主义军团边疆建国范式。
reason_en: Pilsudski not mere dictator but 'legions + federation + miracle + frontier' quaternity federal nation-builder. Legions won independence, Warsaw Miracle stopped Red Army westward, federation concept integrated borderland peoples. M261 distinct from M259 Ulmanis Authoritarian (Ulmanis), M260 Smetona Language (Smetona), M257 Mannerheim War (Mannerheim), core: 'legions as independence force + federation as geopolitical imagination + miracle as survival victory + frontier as strategic depth' Polish federalism legionary frontier nation-building paradigm.
